title: Two spellings of UserCredential coexist in imap crate: re-export unused in auth.rs tests
description:
The aubi commit introduces a re-export pub use stoa_auth::config::UserCredential in crates/imap/src/config.rs, but the test helper make_store() in crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs (lines 315-317) still constructs the type using the full qualified path stoa_auth::config::UserCredential directly, bypassing the re-export.

This leaves two canonical spellings within the same crate:
- stoa_auth::config::UserCredential (used in auth.rs tests)
- crate::config::UserCredential (used in e2e_smoke.rs)

The re-export was introduced precisely to provide a single internal import path. The auth.rs test module should be updated to use the re-exported path to make the re-export's purpose visible and reduce future confusion.

Files:
- crates/imap/src/session/auth.rs lines 314-322 (make_store test helper)
- crates/imap/tests/e2e_smoke.rs lines 13-16 (uses the re-export correctly)
